Data:Salon.end.quiet.informal.json.label: A Quiet Chat Concludes
Data:Salon.end.quiet.informal.json.startdescription: My guests leave content. [For a more successful salon, add more guests, ensure you have the right Soul cards, or both].

Data:Salon.end.quiet.picnic.json.label: A Quiet Picnic Concludes
Data:Salon.end.quiet.picnic.json.startdescription: My guests leave content. [For a more successful salon, add more guests, ensure you have the right Soul cards, or both].

Data:Salon.end.sombre.formal.json.label: A Sombre Meal Concludes
Data:Salon.end.sombre.formal.json.startdescription: My guests leave in silence.  [For a more successful salon, add more guests, ensure you have the right Soul cards, or both].

Data:Salon.end.sombre.informal.json.label: A Sombre Chat Concludes
Data:Salon.end.sombre.informal.json.startdescription: My guests leave in silence. [For a more successful salon, add more guests, ensure you have the right Soul cards, or both].

Data:Salon.end.sombre.picnic.json.label: A Sombre Picnic Concludes
Data:Salon.end.sombre.picnic.json.startdescription: My guests leave in silence.  [For a more successful salon, add more guests, ensure you have the right Soul cards, or both].

Data:Salon.foe.carapace.json.label: Foe: the Carapace Cross
Data:Salon.foe.carapace.json.startdescription: The Institute has resolved that the returning Carapace Cross, and the changes that might come, are the most significant occult threat to mortalkind.

Data:Salon.foe.chandler.json.label: Foe: the Chandler
Data:Salon.foe.chandler.json.startdescription: The Institute has resolved that the coming Hour called Chandler is the most serious occult threat to mortalkind.

Data:Salon.foe.devourers.json.label: Foe: Devourers
Data:Salon.foe.devourers.json.startdescription: The Institute has resolved to guard mortalkind first against the perils of the hidden world: alukites, Mansus-spirits, hungry ghosts...

Data:Salon.foe.none.json.label: Foe: None
Data:Salon.foe.none.json.startdescription: The Institute's founders couldn't agree on the nature of the most significant occult threat.

Data:Salon.foe.nowhere.json.label: Foe: the Nowhere Hours
Data:Salon.foe.nowhere.json.startdescription: The Institute has resolved that the all-consuming horror of the gods-from-Nowhere is the greatest threat mortalkind ever need fear.

Data:Salon.foe.ys.json.label: Foe: Ys
Data:Salon.foe.ys.json.startdescription: The Institute has resolved that Ys, the city beyond the wave, has been left unchallenged too long: its seductions might capsize the waking world.

Data:Salon.gullscry.json.label: A Picnic in the Gullscry Loggia
Data:Salon.gullscry.json.desc: Sombre conversations where once poor Valentine sat alone. [Here one might have a Picnic, but only in Spring or Summer.]

Data:Salon.hint.beverage.json.label: Drinks?
Data:Salon.hint.beverage.json.startdescription: Make sure there's one thing in the room for every visitor to drink.

Data:Salon.hint.course.first.json.label: A First Course?
Data:Salon.hint.course.first.json.startdescription: For Lunch or Supper, you'll always need at least one First Course dish.

Data:Salon.hint.course.main.json.label: A Main Course?
Data:Salon.hint.course.main.json.startdescription: For Lunch or Supper, you'll always need at least one Main Course dish.

Data:Salon.hint.course.side.json.label: A Side Course?
Data:Salon.hint.course.side.json.startdescription: For Lunch or Supper, you'll always need at least one Side Dish.

Data:Salon.hint.formal.early.json.label: A Little Early?
Data:Salon.hint.formal.early.json.startdescription: One might only have Lunch or Supper after midday.

Data:Salon.hint.informal.json.label: A Little Much?
Data:Salon.hint.informal.json.startdescription: One really shouldn't serve Intoxicating drinks with Elevenses or with Afternoon Tea.

Data:Salon.hint.informal.timing.json.label: Not How It's Done
Data:Salon.hint.informal.timing.json.startdescription: One might only have Elevenses in the morning; and Afternoon Tea only at the appropriate time for afternoon tea.

Data:Salon.hint.numa.json.label: Never in Numa
Data:Salon.hint.numa.json.startdescription: Perhaps someone has tried to hold a Salon in Numa at some point. Perhaps at several points. We'll never know, because no records of an attempt have survived. [No Salons in Numa.]

Data:Salon.hint.picnic.late.json.label: A Little Late?
Data:Salon.hint.picnic.late.json.startdescription: One does not picnic when it's too dark to apply jam without peril of jam-related accidents.

Data:Salon.hint.picnicking.json.label: A Little Chilly?
Data:Salon.hint.picnicking.json.startdescription: In this part of the world, we picnic only in Spring and Summer.

Data:Salon.hint.raw.json.label: Raw Food?
Data:Salon.hint.raw.json.startdescription: Raw meat and vegetables might be suitable as gifts to assistants, but not as meals for guests. Make sure there's nothing Raw in the room.

Data:Salon.hint.sustenance.json.label: Food?
Data:Salon.hint.sustenance.json.startdescription: Make sure there's at least one thing in the room for every visitor to eat.

Data:Salon.hint.unsociable.json.label: An Unsociable Visitor?
Data:Salon.hint.unsociable.json.startdescription: Visitors marked as Unsociable are wary of other Visitors. They won't attend the usual kind of Salon - although they will attend a final Salon to inaugurate the Institute.

Data:Salon.institute.hint.json.label: Ready for the Institute's Inaugural Meeting?
Data:Salon.institute.hint.json.startdescription: [Once you've assembled all the Founders, ensure the room contains refreshments - to eat and to drink - as well as your Journal.]

Data:Salon.mission.autarchy.json.label: Mission: Autarchy
Data:Salon.mission.autarchy.json.startdescription: The Institute will learn to survive without the patronage of any Hour... so that one day, mortalkind can do the same.

Data:Salon.mission.better.gods.json.label: Mission: Better Gods
Data:Salon.mission.better.gods.json.startdescription: The Institute will strive to create alternatives to the Hours - substitutes to the cosmic primalities that will be more benevolent, or more biddable.

Data:Salon.mission.consumed.remembered.d.label: Deadlock
Data:Salon.mission.consumed.remembered.d.startdescription: One founder argued that we should honour the gods of the redder sun - another, that they were both a danger and a resource to be consumed...
Data:Salon.mission.consumed.remembered.d.desc: [Deadlock: founders have opposing Agendas. We can't inaugurate the Institute with  Mission: Stone Remembered or Consumed.]

Data:Salon.mission.corrivality.json.label: Mission: Corrivality
Data:Salon.mission.corrivality.json.startdescription: The Corrivality sustains the world, literally and also metaphorically. Without the constant innovations and remaking of war, all humanity will stagnate. The Institute will ensure that does not happen.

Data:Salon.mission.corrivality.peace.dea.label: Deadlock
Data:Salon.mission.corrivality.peace.dea.startdescription: One founder argued for the benefits of conflict. Another insisted on its futility...
Data:Salon.mission.corrivality.peace.dea.desc: [Deadlock: founders have opposing Agendas. We can't inaugurate the Institute with either Mission: Peace or Mission: Corrivality.]

Data:Salon.mission.peace.json.label: Mission: Peace
Data:Salon.mission.peace.json.startdescription: In all the long-marked histories of thinkingkind, war has been an unimaginable scourge. The Institute will set itself to protecting the world from that scourge.

Data:Salon.mission.revelation.json.label: Mission: Revelation
Data:Salon.mission.revelation.json.startdescription: Knowledge can be dangerous: but ignorance is more dangerous still. The Institute will work to free all mortalkind from the tyranny of Calyptra.

Data:Salon.mission.revelation.secrecy.de.label: Deadlock
Data:Salon.mission.revelation.secrecy.de.startdescription: One founder argued that Calyptra protected us - another, that it burdened us intolerably...
Data:Salon.mission.revelation.secrecy.de.desc: [Deadlock: founders have opposing Agendas. We can't inaugurate the Institute with either Mission: Secrecy or Mission: Revelation.]

Data:Salon.mission.secrecy.json.label: Mission: Secrecy
Data:Salon.mission.secrecy.json.startdescription: Some knowledge is too dangerous for the common mind. Calyptra might be tyrannous, but there is a truth at its core - and even if Calyptra were to fall, the Institute would take up their burden.

Data:Salon.mission.stone.consumed.json.label: The Institute's Mission: Stone Consumed
Data:Salon.mission.stone.consumed.json.startdescription: The gods-from-Stone came before the Hours we now know. Their return would be earthquake, famine, wilderness prowling the streets. It will not be permitted. But they are resources as precious as oil or gold or the knowledge in the marrow. The Institute will study them; uncover them; repurpose them, for the benefit of all mortalkind.

Data:Salon.mission.stone.remembered.json.label: Mission: Stone Remembered
Data:Salon.mission.stone.remembered.json.startdescription: The Institute will unrearth, preserve, honour, recall something of the gods-from-stone, who came before the Hours we know.

Data:Salon.mission.uncertain.json.label: The Institute's Mission: Uncertain
Data:Salon.mission.uncertain.json.startdescription: After hours of argument, we were unable to settle to a specific mission, beyond 'to keep all mortalkind from the rocks of eternal night.'

Data:Salon.past.lively.json.label: A Lively Salon
Data:Salon.past.lively.json.desc: You held a lively Salon. [This is a marker to remind you that you can't hold another Salon until next Season.]
